source_title: Extremely harmful to Indian democracy: Rijiju slams Naseeruddin Shah's 'dimagi naxal' video
source_excerpt: New Delhi Union Minister Kiren Rijiju has said Naseeruddin Shah is a "dangerous urban dimagi naxal" whose views are "extremely harmful" to Indian democracy, after the actor posted a video accusing the Centre of trying to destroy the education system. In a post on X on Wednesday (October 28, 2026), the Minister for minority affairs said he used to respect Mr. Shah, but came to know of his "real character" very late. ‘I'm Dimagi naxal and declare it proudly’: Naseeruddin Shah now backs Jamia students with new video ‘I'm Dimagi naxal and declare it proudly’: Naseeruddin Shah now backs Jamia students with new video Last week, Naseeruddin Shah had also come out in support of the Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute students who have staged an indefinite sit-in over violent incidents on the campus ‘I'm Dimagi naxal and declare it proudly’: Naseeruddin Shah now backs Jamia students with new video storyline 1 In a video posted on Facebook on Tuesday (October 27, 2026), a visibly angry Mr. Shah came out in support of Jamia Millia Islamia students, who have been protesting for the restoration of the students' union, and called himself a "dimagi naxal". He accused the BJP-led central government of trying to destroy the education system and break the "courage of the country's youth". Shah was also wearing a "dimagi naxal" pin that he showed to the camera. Mr. Rijiju criticised the actor, saying, "I thought Naseeruddin Shah was just an ordinary actor. I used to respect & like him... I never knew that he was a dangerous urban Dimagi Naxal." The politics of calling minds ‘Naxal’ The politics of calling minds ‘Naxal’ The new labelling is an escalation of the government’s attitude towards dissent and democracy The politics of calling minds ‘Naxal’ opinion 1 "I came to know about his real character very late. (His views are) extremely harmful to India's democracy," he added. The term 'dimagi naxal' was first used by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in his Independence Day address. He described "dimagi naxals" as those who have allegedly entrenched themselves in the system and continue to pose a threat to society by manipulating policies. Speaking to PTI Videos, Shiv Sena leader Shaina NC also questioned Mr. Shah over his remarks. She said, "The question is whether Naseeruddin Shah is ACP Rathod or Gulam Hassan of 'Sarfarosh'. He talks about urban naxalism, supporting the tukde-tukde gang, anti-national movements. The question to you, sir, with utmost respect, is do you believe in pro-India sloganeering or anti-India." Shah played the antagonist, covert operator Gulfam Hassan, in the Aamir Khan-starrer action drama "Sarfarosh". Khan played the role of the protagonist, ACP Ajay Singh Rathod, in the 1999 superhit. Mr. Shah, 76, has been posting frequent videos, voicing his support for students-related issues and has criticised the government for its handling of the Cockroach Janta Party-led protest over NEET exam irregularities in July. Last week, Mr. Shah had also come out in support of the Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute students, who have are on an indefinite sit-in over violent incidents on the campus. In his video on Tuesday (October 27, 2026), he said, "I proudly declare that I am 'dimagi naxal'. I don't know what other nicknames the watchmen have given to people like me, anti-national, 'tukde-tukde' gang, and I don't know what else." "... I want to ask this government a question... What else will you do to break the courage of our country's youth, to destroy the education system, and to put our democracy at risk? How much will you do? How far will you go?" he said in Hindi.
hi_body:
केंद्रीय मंत्री किरेन रिजिजू ने अभिनेता नसीरुद्दीन शाह की आलोचना करते हुए उन्हें एक "खतरनाक शहरी दिमागी नक्सल" बताया है और कहा है कि उनके विचार भारतीय लोकतंत्र के लिए "अत्यंत हानिकारक" हैं। यह प्रतिक्रिया अभिनेता द्वारा सोशल मीडिया पर एक वीडियो साझा किए जाने के बाद आई है।

बुधवार (28 अक्टूबर, 2026) को प्रकाशित रिपोर्टों के अनुसार, मंत्री किरेन रिजिजू ने एक्स (पूर्व में ट्विटर) पर एक पोस्ट में कहा कि वह पहले अभिनेता का सम्मान करते थे, लेकिन उनके "असली चरित्र" के बारे में उन्हें बहुत देर से पता चला।

## विवाद की पृष्ठभूमि
* **अभिनेता का वीडियो:** मंगलवार (27 अक्टूबर, 2026) को एक वीडियो में अभिनेता नसीरुद्दीन शाह ने जामिया मिलिया इस्लामिया के छात्रों का समर्थन किया, जो छात्र संघ की बहाली के लिए विरोध प्रदर्शन कर रहे हैं।
* **दिए गए बयान:** श्री शाह ने खुद को "दिमागी नक्सल" घोषित किया, इस वाक्यांश का एक पिन पहना और केंद्र सरकार पर शिक्षा प्रणाली को नष्ट करने तथा देश के युवाओं का हौसला तोड़ने का आरोप लगाया।
* **पिछला समर्थन:** पिछले सप्ताह, श्री शाह ने सत्यजीत रे फिल्म एंड टेलीविजन इंस्टीट्यूट के छात्रों के प्रति भी समर्थन व्यक्त किया था, जो परिसर की हिंसक घटनाओं को लेकर अनिश्चितकालीन धरने पर बैठे हैं।

## प्रतिक्रियाएं और राजनीतिक संदर्भ
शिवसेना नेता शायना एनसी ने भी पीटीआई वीडियो को दिए बयनों में श्री शाह की टिप्पणियों पर सवाल उठाए और प्रो-इंडिया बनाम राष्ट्र-विरोधी आंदोलनों पर उनके रुख का हवाला दिया।

"दिमागी नक्सल" शब्द का इस्तेमाल सबसे पहले प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र उन स्वतंत्रता दिवस के भाषण में किया गया था, जिसमें ऐसे व्यक्तियों का वर्णन किया गया था जो कथित तौर पर व्यवस्था में गहराई तक पैठ बना चुके हैं और नीतियों में हेरफेर करके समाज के लिए खतरा पैदा कर रहे हैं।

## व्यावहारिक निहितार्थ और सत्यापन
इन बयानों की पुष्टि करने के इच्छुक पाठक संबंधित नेताओं के आधिकारिक सोशल मीडिया हैंडल की जांच कर सकते हैं और अक्टूबर 2026 की सत्यापित समाचार एजेंसी की रिपोर्टों की समीक्षा कर सकते हैं। आधिकारिक घोषणाओं और सरकारी रुख को आमतौर पर प्राथमिक ministerial प्रेस विज्ञप्तियों के माध्यम से प्रलेखित किया जाता है।

en_body:
Union Minister Kiren Rijiju has publicly criticised actor Naseeruddin Shah, calling him a "dangerous urban dimagi naxal" and stating that his views are "extremely harmful" to Indian democracy. The remarks follow a video posted by Mr. Shah on social media.

According to reports published on Wednesday (October 28, 2026), Mr. Rijiju stated in a post on X that while he used to respect the actor, he learned of his "real character" very late. 

## Background of the Controversy

* **Actor's Video:** In a video posted on Tuesday (October 27, 2026), actor Naseeruddin Shah supported Jamia Millia Islamia students who have been protesting for the restoration of the students' union.
* **Statements Made:** Mr. Shah declared himself a "dimagi naxal" while wearing a pin with the phrase and accused the central government of attempting to destroy the education system and break the courage of the country's youth.
* **Prior Support:** Last week, Mr. Shah also expressed support for Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute students who staged an indefinite sit-in over campus violent incidents.

## Reactions and Political Context

Shiv Sena leader Shaina NC also questioned Mr. Shah's remarks in statements to PTI Videos, raising questions regarding his views on pro-India versus anti-national movements and referencing his past film roles.

The term "dimagi naxal" was initially used by Prime Minister Narendra Modi during an Independence Day address to describe individuals alleged to have entrenched themselves in the system and posing threats by manipulating policies.

## Practical Implications and Verification

Readers seeking to verify these statements can check official social media handles of the mentioned leaders and review verified news agency reports from October 2026. Official announcements and government positions are typically documented through primary ministerial press releases and verified public posts.
en_title: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju Slams Actor Naseeruddin Shah Over 'Dimagi Naxal' Video
